Mr. M.A Wahab Mia with Mr. Obaidul Hassan, Advocates: For the Appellant

parties:
Abu Shama ------ Appellant

full_judgment:
Now, let us consider the above submission of the learned Advocates on the basis of the evidence on record. As has been stated earlier that in the instant case, the prosecution has examined only 5 P.Ws. and tendered one namely P.W.6 Abdul Barek P.W.1. Md. Rustom Ali is the father of the victim Samaun and he is the informant in this case. He has stated in his examination-in-chief that his son Samaun on 28.7.86 went out along with Abul Hossain, P.W.2 Abdul Hye, P.W.3 and Abdul Hakim P.W.4 to work in his land, then the 8 accused persons namely A. Razzak, Abu Shama, Abdul Malek, Mokbul Hossain, Tara Miah, Rois Miah, Kadem Ilia and Abu Baker went there by 2 boats with deadly weapons and gheraoed them and then accused appellant Abu Shama forcibly uprooted a tooth of the victim Samaun and accused Razzak gave a kirich blow on him and thereafter the rest of the accused took the victim to the house of the said Razzak by boat. This witness states that he was at home at that time but thereafter he went to the Nabinagar Police-Station and lodged the ejhar and started searching for his son in Baghaura and Monikara, but could not find him out. On the following day, he went to the Police-Station and found his son sitting in a bleeding condition before the Officer-in-Charge of the police station. The victim was then taken by PW. 1 his father to the nearby hospital for treatment and on quiry the victim disclosed the names of the accused. Then the informant lodged another Ejhar which has been proved as Ext. 1 and his signature as Ext. 1(1).He identified the accused Abu Baker in the dock. He has farther stated that his son went to the and with witness Abdul Hye P.W.3 at about 7/7.30 a.m. in the morning and that he got the information about the occurrence at about 1.00 p.m. from Abdul Hossain P.W.2 and Abdul Hakim P.W.4 and that no other person was present there at that time. He further sates that at the time of occurrence the land was under water and it was the month of Shrabon and that the witnesses went to work with his son by way of exchange and not as labourers. He heared from his son and other witnesses that there were many persons working in the field he could not of course narrate the Plot Number and the Khatian Number of the land, but he gave out the names of the owners of the lands adjacent to the place of occurrence. He further states that just near the place of occurrence Abdul Hossain P.W.2 and Abdul Hakim P.W.4 have their lands. He denied a suggestion that he did not mention that he went to the place of occurrence by boat .He has stated that his house is at a distance of F (1, 4) tin mile towards the east from the place of occurrence. He further states that at the time of taking the victim to the house of accused Razzak Miah, people of the neighbourhood fled away. He however sent his son-in-law Quddus to bring information about his son, but the said Quddus is not a witness in this case. He further states that local Sardars and Matbars came to his house but they did not go to the house of Razzak. He states that he informed the Police orally and the G.C. recorded the same and the police came to his house on the basis of that information and the regular F.I.R was lodged subsequently on the following day. He states that he went to the Police-Station between 3 to 4 p.m. being accompanied by one A. Hashem and the Daroga then came to his house before the Magreb prayer. He further states that on the following day he went to the police station with one Mostofa but be has also not been examined in this case as a witness. This witness further states that he admitted his son into the hospital on the 12th Shrabon but could not remember the date when he received the certificate. He states that he had previous enmity with the accused persons. He also states that his son identified the house of the accused persons to the O.C. in another case in which Abu Shama was ultimately convicted and sentenced. He further states that while he was making search for his son he was accompanied by 6/7 persons, namely Mostofa, Master Hashim, Shahid Sarker etc. He has further stated that there are many house of respectable persons around his house but they have not been made witnesses in this case. He denied a suggestion that some relations of the accused gave resistance to victim Shamaun, when he was along with some others committing theft of a fishing net on 28.7.86. He also denied a suggestion that the local people caught hold of his son while he was steeling a fishing net and handed him over to the Chairman Abdul Hug. He denied the suggestion that the case was false and the story of going to the land for work and also taking the victim to some unknown place are also false. 

 7. P.W.2 Abul Hossain stated in this deposition that on 28.7.86 corresponding to the 11th Shrabon 1393 B.S. at about 12 noon, the occurrence had taken place. He stated that he along with Liton Miah alias Sharnaun and Hakim P.W.4 went to work in the field at about 12 noon when 8 accused persons including accused Malekcame to the place of occurrence by boats and gheraoed the victim and then accused Abu Shama uprooted a tooth of the victim Liton & Shamaun by par (blow) and accused Razzak gave him a kirich blow and then caught hold of the victim and took him to their house. He stated that he then informed the father of the victim who thereafter went out in search of his son and on the following day found his son in an injured condition in the police station. He states that the informant started a case at Nabinagar Police Station and got his son Shamaun medically treated in the hospital. He heard the names of accused Abu Bakar and Shama from him. He identified accused Abu Bakar in the dock. He made statements before the police. In cross-examination he stated that Abdul Hye P. W. 3 and Rustom P. W. 1 were of the same village and Abdul Hakim P. W. 4 is a cousin of the informant. He states that he went to the field at 7/8 a. m. In the morning and that the occurrence had taken place after 3 hours. He could not say the number of the plot or of the khatian of the place of occurrence and he could not say also the boundary of the place of occurrence. He states that in one boat Tara 

 8. P. W. 3 Abdul Hye is a man of the same village he went to Baghaura for catching fishes and heard that the father of Makbul namely Malek and assaulted Liton and taken him away to the house of the said Makbul and that subsequently the victim was found in the Thana. In cross examination he stated that he had seen the occurrence from a distance of a kanis of land but he was unable to tell the number of the plot or khatian or the boundaries of the said place of occurrence. He also could not say whether Liton @ Shamaun was along or was with his associates. He could not say how the accused arrive there. He did not go to the house of the informant and also could not say how the victim was found out on the following day. He denied a suggestion that he gave false evidence at the instance of the informant. 

 9. P.W. 4 Md. Abdul Hakim has stated that on the 11th Aswin 1393 B.S. he went to the Baghaura Beel for work along with Abul Hossain P.VV. 2 and Samaun the victim when accused Makbul, Abu Shama, Razzak, Tara Miah, Malek, Rois Miah, Sadek and Abu Bakkar attacked them that accused Abu Shama uprooted one tooth of the victim Shamaul and accused Razzak Mia gave him a kirich blow and others caught hold of the said victim Samaun. The informant could not find out his son even after search and only on the following day he could find his son in that; police-station with Abdul Hug Chairman. He however identified accused Abu Bakar in the dock. In cross examination, he states that he is a neighbour of the informant who used to move with one A. Hye. He states that he went with victim Samaun to work in the field and that he has lands near the place of occurrence towards the west but he could not give the plot number or khatian number of the same. He states that the accused persons came to the place of occurrence from their houses and that the occurrence had taken place towards the east of the houses of both the informant and the accused persons. He states that the tooth of the victim was broken and a kirich blow was given upon him and then the victim was taken to the Chairman. He could not say where the victim passed the night. He could not say whether other people were working around the place of occurrence. He states that the house of the Chairman is toward the southern east corner from the place of occurrence. This witness did not go out for searching the victim, but he also gave information to the informant P. W. 1 and then left for his house. He and one Abul Hossain collectively gave the information to the informant. He states that one Abdul Haque the Chairman produced the victim to the Police-station. He denied a suggestion that he gave false evidence as he was the cousin of the informant. He also denied the suggestion that no such occurrence had taken place on the day and at the time as narrated. He further denied the suggestion that he was giving false evidence. 

 Now, drawing our attention to the provisions of the said Section of the Penal Code, the learned Advocate for the appellant argued that to punish an accused under Section 364 of the Penal Code, the prosecution is not only to prove kidnapping or abduction, but it has to further prove that kidnapping or abduction must be in order that such person may be murdered or may be so disposed of as to be put into the danger of being murdered in the instant case from the evidence of the P.Ws. as quoted above it is found that P.VV.2 Abul Hossain and P.W.4 Abdul Hakim are said to be the only eye witnesses of the actual occurrence. The other 2 witnesses namely. P.W.3 Abdul Hye and P.W.5 Abdul Mia are the hearsay witnesses. P.W.1 the informant is not an eye witness of the occurrence. Now, from the evidence of P.W.2 it appears that there were 8 accused persons altogether who took part in the occurrence .It further appears from his evidence that the accused appellant Abu Shama alleged uprooted one tooth of the victim Liton by part (below) and accused Razzak gave a kirich blow on him but it may be noticed that in the charge, there was no mention of using any kirich by the accused, rather it appears that a lathi blow was given. In his cross-examination, this witness has stated that the accused came by 2 boats to the place of occurrence one driven by Tara Mia and another driven by Mukul; but this version of this P. W. has not been corroborated by the other eye witness P. W. 4 though according to the prosecution he was working in the same field along with the victim Liton as well as the other P. W. 2 Abul Hossain. P. W. 4 has not uttered a single word about the arrival of the accused person at the place of occurrence by any boat. P. W. 1 the informant also though he lodged the F. I. R. after consulting with his son the victim Shamaun did not speak of the arrival of the accused at the P. O by any boat in the F. 1. R. 0 of course in evidence he has stated about 2 boats in a vague way. About up-rooting of the tooth of the victim by accused Abu Shama P. W. 2 has said so that it was done by a par but P. W. 4 Abdul Hakim has not said further P. W. 1 being the informant has also not mentioned in the F. I. R. as to how the tooth of the victim was uprooted. It is of course in the evidence of P. W. 1 that he met his son on the 29th of July. 1986 in the local thana and found him in an injured condition sitting before the Officer-in-charge. He then took the victim with him to the local hospital and gave him medical treatments and thereafter obtained a medical certificate from the doctor which according to him he produced before the O. C of the Police-station at the time of the lodging the regular F. I. R. on the 30th July 1986. But so far medical treatment of the victim Samaun is concerned P. W. 4 has not said anything. P. W. 2 of course, has said in his examination in chief that the victim was given medical treatment in the hospital. Now on scrutiny of the records, we don't find any such medical certificate from the Doctor concerned or from anybody of the Hospital and curiously enough that nobody has been cited as a witness to prove such medical treatment meted out to the victim as alleged by the prosecution. However, there is another allegation from the prosecution that accused Razzak gave a kirich blow on the body of the victim and caused him bleeding injury, there is no independent evidence to prove such allegation. It further appears from the deposition of P.W.2 that after the occurrence the victim Liton was forcibly taken away by the accused from the field and he (P. W. 2) and P. W. 4 went to the father of the victim and gave him the information about the occurrence, but P. W. 1 stated that P. W. 2, P. W. 3 and P. W. 4 went together with his son to the field for working but about the occurrence P. W. 2 said that he (P. W. 2) and P. W. 4 only went to the field for working with the victim Liton. He does not speak of the other witnesses P. W. 3 Abdul Hye, so evidence of this witness P. W. 2 does not tally with the evidence of P. W. 1 in this regard. Rather, it is in the evidence of P. W. 2 that he went to Baghaura on the date of occurrence for catching fishes. His evidence also does not tally with that of P. W. 1 and further P. W 3. appears to be a hearsay witness as regards the occurrence, but in cross-examination, he has of course stated that he had seen the occurrence from a distance of 8 Kanis of land though he failed to narrate the plot number and khatian number or the boundaries of the plot of the place of occurrence and also failed to say whether Liton @ Samaun the victim was alone there or he was with his other associates. So, his evidence also does not inspire confidence and the same is not so helpful for the prosecution. How, as to the matter of taking away the victim after assaulting him, it is in the evidence of P. W. 1 that the victim was taken to the house of accused Abdul Razzak, but P. W. 2 vaguely stated that after the assault, the victim was taken away presumably to the house of the accused and has not mentioned anything specifically. Again P. W. 3 has come to say both in his examination in chief and the cross-examination that he heard that Samaun the victim after his assault by Malek was taken to the house of accused Mokbul. P. W. 4 in examination-in-Chief has not said anything specific as to where the victim was taken away after being assaulted, but in his cross-examination he has stated that after the assault the victim was taken to the local Chairman, of course he could not say where the victim actually passed the night after the occurrence. P. W. 5 Abdul Miah who is also a hearsay witness has stated that he heard that the victim was taken to the house of accused Razzak and Razzak handed over the victim to the Chairman.
